title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.13.747
body_markdown:
### Added

* Enable access to 'Nightly (Agent)' update channel via Copilot preferences. This channel provides highly improved but experimental integration with Github Copilot.
* Support for IntelliJ 2021.1 and Android Studio Bumblebee

### Fixed

* Fixed errors when showing multiple solutions for certain file types.
